+# Query only verified scalar leaves after an actual call has been selected.
+# Follow identity returns, never computed values or conversion instructions.
+# These canonical bindings do not replace raw scalar arithmetic facts.
+def mir_selected_return_binding(native_module: Gate4MirModule, function_index: Integer, bindings: Array<Integer>): Integer
+	function := native_module.functions[gate4_mir_function_index(native_module, function_index)]
+	block := native_module.blocks[gate4_mir_block_index(native_module, function, function[1])]
+	mut value := block[15]
+	if gate4_mir_value_type(native_module, function_index, value) != 1
+		return 0
+	end
+	mut index := block[5] + block[6]
+	while index > block[5]
+		index -= 1
+		instruction := native_module.instructions[index]
+		if instruction[1] == value
+			if instruction[0] == 6
+				if gate4_small_nonnegative_integer_operand(gate4_number_without_underscores(native_module.literal_texts[instruction[4]]))
+					return 1
+				end
+				return 0
+			end
+			if instruction[0] != 8
+				return 0
+			end
+			if instruction[4] != 3
+				return 0
+			end
+			value = instruction[2]
+		end
+	end
+	index = 0
+	while index < function[5]
+		if native_module.arguments[function[4] + index] == value
+			return bindings[index] / 2
+		end
+		index += 1
+	end
+	return 0
+end
